name: Energetic Resurgence
source: This is a Horror Comedy Visual Novel, Set in Halloween, You will play as Jake. Jake with his friends are doing Nightout party in their first day of vacation. Suddenly something happens to one of the friend, Choice is yours. You have to make a decision to help and save your friend, If you won't She will...
translation: 这是一部恐怖喜剧视觉小说，以万圣节为背景，你将扮演杰克。假期第一天，杰克和他的朋友们正在举办夜生活派对。突然，一位朋友发生了什么事，选择是你的。你必须做出决定来帮助和拯救你的朋友，如果你不这样做，她会……
